ex.en: A great number of books are published every year.
ex.zh: 每年都有大量的書出版。

ex.en: He has written a book, however, he has no money to publish it.
ex.zh: 他寫了一本書，可是沒錢出版。

ex.en: He publishes books in Italy.
ex.zh: 他在義大利出版圖書。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: The results will be published next month.
ex.zh: 結果將於下個月公布。

ex.en: The purchaser must sign the contract.
ex.zh: 買方必須簽署合約。

ex.en: The purchaser has 30 days to return the item.
ex.zh: 購買者有 30 天可以退貨。

ex.en: She found her purse under the desk.
ex.zh: 她在書桌底下找到了她的錢包。

ex.en: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
ex.zh: 我突然想到我把錢包忘在家裡了。

ex.en: I had my purse stolen in the bus.
ex.zh: 我的錢包在公車上被偷了。

ex.en: She pursed her lips and said nothing.
ex.zh: 她抿著嘴，什麼也沒說。

ex.en: He pursed his lips in disapproval.
ex.zh: 他不以為然地噘起嘴。

ex.en: She doesn't like people who are not punctual.
ex.zh: 她不喜歡不守時的人。

ex.en: I make a point of being punctual.
ex.zh: 我很注重準時。

ex.en: You can rely upon his being punctual.
ex.zh: 你放心，他一定會準時。

ex.en: Tom was a bit puzzled by Mary's answer.
ex.zh: 瑪麗的回答讓湯姆有點困惑。

ex.en: Tom was puzzled by what Mary said.
ex.zh: 瑪麗說的話讓湯姆很困惑。

ex.en: I was puzzled about what to do next.
ex.zh: 我不知道接下來該做什麼，感到很困惑。

ex.en: No one could solve the puzzle.
ex.zh: 沒人解得了這個謎題。

ex.en: Can you solve this puzzle?
ex.zh: 你能解開這個謎題嗎？

ex.en: We spent the afternoon doing a jigsaw puzzle.
ex.zh: 我們花了一個下午拼拼圖。

ex.en: We need to publicize the event on social media.
ex.zh: 我們需要在社群媒體上宣傳這個活動。

ex.en: The company widely publicized its new product.
ex.zh: 公司大力宣傳它的新產品。

purser.zh: （飛機的）座艙長；（船上的）事務長

ex.en: The purser welcomed the passengers on board.
ex.zh: 座艙長歡迎乘客登機。

ex.en: Please ask the purser if you need any help.
ex.zh: 需要協助的話，請找座艙長。

ex.en: Publicly express your love for someone.
ex.zh: 公開表達你對某人的愛。

ex.en: The CEO publicly apologized for the mistake.
ex.zh: 執行長公開為這個錯誤道歉。

ex.en: The company's shares are publicly traded.
ex.zh: 這家公司的股票公開上市交易。

ex.en: You'll be punished if you break the law.
ex.zh: 如果你違法，就會受到懲罰。

ex.en: My mother never punishes me.
ex.zh: 我媽媽從來不處罰我。

ex.en: Tom wanted to punish me.
ex.zh: 湯姆想處罰我。

ex.en: What punishment awaits him?
ex.zh: 他會受到什麼樣的懲罰？

ex.en: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
ex.zh: 許多國家已經廢除了死刑。

ex.en: Cleaning the classroom was his punishment for being late.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是他遲到的處罰。

ex.en: I met him purely by chance.
ex.zh: 我遇到他純屬巧合。

ex.en: This decision was made purely for financial reasons.
ex.zh: 這個決定純粹是基於財務考量。

ex.en: The trip is purely for business.
ex.zh: 這趟行程純粹是出差。

ex.en: The company is in pursuit of new markets.
ex.zh: 公司正在開拓新市場。

ex.en: Everyone has the right to the pursuit of happiness.
ex.zh: 每個人都有追求幸福的權利。

ex.en: Reading is one of my favorite pursuits.
ex.zh: 閱讀是我最喜歡的休閒活動之一。

ex.en: Hiking is a popular outdoor pursuit in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 爬山是台灣很受歡迎的戶外活動。

ex.en: Pursuant to the contract, payment is due in 30 days.
ex.zh: 依據合約，款項須於三十天內支付。

ex.en: The meeting was held pursuant to company rules.
ex.zh: 這場會議依照公司規定召開。

ex.en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
ex.zh: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。

ex.en: Mary puts salt on just about everything she eats.
ex.zh: 瑪莉吃什麼都要加鹽。

ex.en: Put your bag on the chair.
ex.zh: 把你的包包放在椅子上。

ex.en: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.
ex.zh: 我受不了他那種無禮的態度。

ex.en: You have to put up with all these noises.
ex.zh: 你得忍受這些噪音。

ex.en: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
ex.zh: 派對已經延到下週二。

ex.en: Don't put off your work until tomorrow.
ex.zh: 別把工作拖到明天。

ex.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
ex.zh: 穿上鞋子，我們出去吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: Put on your jacket; it's cold.
ex.zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

ex.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
ex.zh: 我看到一匹馬拉著一台馬車。

ex.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.
ex.zh: 只要把門拉上就好，它會自動上鎖。

ex.en: He pulled up the weed and threw it away.
ex.zh: 他把雜草拔起來丟掉。

ex.en: I need a tool for pulling weeds in my garden.
ex.zh: 我需要一個工具來拔花園裡的雜草。

ex.en: The car pulled up in front of the bank.
ex.zh: 那輛車在銀行前停了下來。

ex.en: A taxi pulled up outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 一輛計程車停在飯店外面。

ex.en: I saw Tom pushing a stroller down the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 我看到湯姆推著嬰兒車走在人行道上。

ex.en: We got behind the car and pushed.
ex.zh: 我們繞到車子後面推車。

ex.en: He fouled because he pushed over the other player.
ex.zh: 他犯規了，因為他把對方球員推倒了。

ex.en: Push the red button if something strange happens.
ex.zh: 如果發生奇怪的事，就按紅色按鈕。

ex.en: I don't know which button to push.
ex.zh: 我不知道要按哪個按鈕。

ex.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
ex.zh: 慧如還沒把簡報傳過來嗎？客戶在催了。

ex.en: My parents pushed me to study harder.
ex.zh: 我爸媽逼我更用功讀書。

ex.en: The company is pushing for faster growth.
ex.zh: 公司正積極推動更快速的成長。

ex.en: Some people pursue only pleasure.
ex.zh: 有些人只追求享樂。

ex.en: She left her job to pursue her dream.
ex.zh: 她辭掉工作去追求夢想。

ex.en: He plans to pursue a career in law.
ex.zh: 他打算從事法律工作。

ex.en: We decided not to pursue the matter further.
ex.zh: 我們決定不再追究這件事。

ex.en: The police are pursuing an escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方正在追捕一名逃犯。

ex.en: The police will pursue her for a long time.
ex.zh: 警察會追捕她很長一段時間。

ex.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
ex.zh: 這篇文章特意安排在教授生日那天發表。

ex.en: The book is ready for publication.
ex.zh: 這本書已經可以出版了。

ex.en: The company has several monthly publications.
ex.zh: 這家公司有好幾份月刊。

ex.en: This publication is available online for free.
ex.zh: 這份刊物可以在網路上免費閱讀。

ex.en: How many pupils are there in your school?
ex.zh: 你們學校有多少學生？

ex.en: This class is made up of thirty-five pupils.
ex.zh: 這個班有三十五名學生。

ex.en: The doctor checked the size of my pupils.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了我瞳孔的大小。

ex.en: Your pupils get bigger in the dark.
ex.zh: 在暗處瞳孔會放大。

ex.en: There's a pub just around the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角就有一家酒吧。

ex.en: We're going down the pub. Do you fancy coming?
ex.zh: 我們要去酒吧，你想一起來嗎？

ex.en: These fabrics are made of pure wool.
ex.zh: 這些布料是純羊毛製的。

ex.en: Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.
ex.zh: 歐洲人平均每年喝下 12.5 公升的純酒精。

ex.en: The sample is not pure enough.
ex.zh: 樣本不夠純淨。

ex.en: The water from this spring is very pure.
ex.zh: 這口泉水非常純淨。

ex.en: It was pure luck that we met.
ex.zh: 我們會相遇純粹是運氣。

ex.en: It was pure chance that I found the file.
ex.zh: 我找到這份檔案純屬偶然。

ex.en: The water pump in the basement is broken.
ex.zh: 地下室的抽水馬達壞了。

ex.en: I need a pump for my bike tires.
ex.zh: 我需要一個打氣筒幫腳踏車輪胎打氣。

ex.en: We pumped the water out of the basement.
ex.zh: 我們把地下室的水抽出來。

ex.en: He pumped air into the tires.
ex.zh: 他幫輪胎打氣。

ex.en: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
ex.zh: 這家出版社專門出版兒童文學。

ex.en: The publisher will release her new book in May.
ex.zh: 出版社將在五月推出她的新書。

ex.en: He sent his novel to several publishers.
ex.zh: 他把小說寄給了好幾家出版社。

ex.en: The doctor is taking the patient's pulse.
ex.zh: 醫生正在幫病人量脈搏。

ex.en: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
ex.zh: 醫生認為病人的脈搏有點快。

ex.en: Is his pulse regular?
ex.zh: 他的脈搏規律嗎？

pulse.zh: (have/keep) a finger on the pulse：掌握最新動態

ex.en: She has her finger on the pulse.
ex.zh: 她總能掌握最新的潮流動態。

ex.en: A good manager keeps a finger on the pulse of the market.
ex.zh: 好的經理會隨時掌握市場動態。

ex.en: Music pulsed through the room.
ex.zh: 音樂的節奏在房間裡迴盪。

ex.en: The lights pulsed to the beat.
ex.zh: 燈光隨著節拍閃動。

ex.en: I punched Tom.
ex.zh: 我揍了湯姆一拳。

ex.en: The boxer punched the bag again and again.
ex.zh: 拳擊手一拳又一拳地打著沙包。

ex.en: He gave the punching bag a hard punch.
ex.zh: 他朝沙包狠狠打了一拳。

ex.en: She threw a punch at the training pad.
ex.zh: 她朝訓練用的護墊揮了一拳。

ex.en: The conductor punched my ticket.
ex.zh: 列車長幫我剪了票。

ex.en: Punch two holes in the paper and put it in the binder.
ex.zh: 在紙上打兩個洞，然後放進資料夾。

ex.en: Would you like a glass of punch?
ex.zh: 要來一杯水果酒嗎？

ex.en: She made a big bowl of fruit punch for the party.
ex.zh: 她為派對調了一大碗水果酒。

ex.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
ex.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和標點符號。

ex.en: An exclamation mark is a punctuation mark.
ex.zh: 感嘆號是標點符號。

ex.en: Try not to forget punctuation next time.
ex.zh: 下次儘量別忘了加標點。

ex.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
ex.zh: 這個城鎮的人已經不再重視公共道德。

ex.en: Smoking is not allowed in public places.
ex.zh: 公共場所禁止吸菸。

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這場展覽引起了大眾的高度關注。

ex.en: The museum is open to the public every day.
ex.zh: 博物館每天對外開放。

ex.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣當眾說話了。

ex.en: The politician didn't appear in public after the incident.
ex.zh: 那件事之後，那位政治人物就沒再公開露面。

ex.en: You don't have to worry about publicity.
ex.zh: 你不用擔心宣傳的事。

ex.en: The scandal brought a lot of negative publicity.
ex.zh: 這場醜聞帶來很多負面報導。

ex.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
ex.zh: 那種藥沒有處方就買不到。

ex.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
ex.zh: 購票前需要先輸入個人資料。

ex.en: If I had the money, I would immediately purchase this computer.
ex.zh: 我要是有錢，馬上就買這台電腦。

ex.en: They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
ex.zh: 他們在存錢買房子。

ex.en: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
ex.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

ex.en: Punctuality is important for client meetings.
ex.zh: 與客戶開會時，準時很重要。

ex.en: Her punctuality made a good impression on the team.
ex.zh: 她守時的態度讓團隊留下好印象。

ex.en: He went to Italy for the purpose of studying music.
ex.zh: 他去義大利的目的是學習音樂。

ex.en: She came to Japan for the purpose of studying Japanese.
ex.zh: 她為了學習日文來到日本。

ex.en: Many people drift through life without a purpose.
ex.zh: 許多人毫無目的地隨波逐流。

ex.en: You made the mistake on purpose, didn't you?
ex.zh: 你是故意犯這個錯的，對吧？

ex.en: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
ex.zh: 他為了惹惱我故意犯錯。

ex.en: We can't ship the goods until we receive a purchase order.
ex.zh: 收到採購單之前，我們無法出貨。

ex.en: Please write the purchase order number on the invoice.
ex.zh: 請在請款單上寫上採購單號碼。

ex.en: Could you put me through to the sales department?
ex.zh: 可以幫我轉接業務部嗎？

ex.en: Please hold while I put you through.
ex.zh: 請稍候，我幫您轉接。
